subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw change default visible reply policy for direct/source channel chats and cron announce delivery so bare assistant text is private unless it is a final answer or an explicit message-tool send?
rationale: Current source behavior preserves automatic bare-text delivery for compatibility, while multiple production reports show that the same behavior can expose internal assistant text to external messaging recipients.

options.title: Adopt stricter default delivery
options.body: Move source-channel and cron delivery toward final-only or message-tool-only semantics, with migration or opt-out coverage for existing bare-text workflows.

options.title: Keep compatibility default
options.body: Keep automatic bare-text delivery by default and require users to opt into message-tool-only or final-tag behavior for sensitive channels.

options.title: Land only opt-in mitigations
options.body: Land the narrower final-tag or verbose-off candidates first while leaving the direct-chat default policy for a separate maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt stricter default delivery
recommendation.body: Move source-channel and cron delivery toward final-only or message-tool-only semantics, with migration or opt-out coverage for existing bare-text workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and adjacent delivery/commentary history connect this owner most directly to the central source-reply and embedded-message delivery paths.
